definitions.explanation: The half of the Earth south of the equator. Includes most of South America, Africa, Australia, and Antarctica.

examples.japanese: ⟦オーストラリア→オーストラリア：28144_oosutoraria⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南半球|みなみはんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Australia is in the Southern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: {南半球|みなみはんきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the Southern Hemisphere, the seasons are reversed.

examples.english: In Southern Hemisphere countries, December is summer, so some people spend Christmas at the beach.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧ (south) + {半球|はんきゅう} (hemisphere).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南半球|みなみはんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧: Southern Hemisphere countries
- {南半球|みなみはんきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧: seasons are reversed in the Southern Hemisphere

KEY FACT:
Japan is in the ⟦{北半球|きたはんきゅう}→北半球：20906_kitahankyuu⟧ (Northern Hemisphere), so seasons are opposite to those in Australia, New Zealand, and much of South America.
